pages.title: European Hippopotamus
pages.text: The European hippopotamus ($(o)Hippopotamus antiquus$()) lived in the rivers and lakes of Europe from about 2 million until about 400,000 years ago.$(br2)It was the largest hippo ever, around twice the weight of a living hippo, with its eyes set higher on the skull and shorter feet.$(br2)It spread as far north as England only during warm interglacials, and the dwarf hippos of Crete are thought to have descended from it.
